skill.name: Manifold Bloom
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, consume STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> then release the button to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, continuously consuming STA and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color></size>
When the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button is released during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, or when the skill ends, Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease </color>, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack- Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1</color> generates a <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> at the target's position. Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> causes the <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> to collapse, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Upward Cut - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and Hsin is in mid-air, <color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> is repalced with <color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color>.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3</color>.

skill.name: Heartward by Moon
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, if Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color>.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, She turns into the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color>. 
- While turned into the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> and out of combat, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color>. With <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color>, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color> is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While turned into the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> and out of combat, Hsin restores {0} of Max HP each second.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> or taking damage ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form and makes Hsin immune to DMG and interruption for a short time. Switching to another Resonator or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pessing} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> also ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form and casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Answering Form</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold a directional key while casting this skill to turn Hsin into the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> after a short time. While out of combat, She restores a certain amount of HP per second.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skill.name: Nexus Alight
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Formshift</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Formshift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Formshift</color> to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin turns into <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, engaging in <color=Highlight>quest dialogue</color>, performing a <color=Highlight>environmental interaction with an animation</color>, or using a <color=Highlight>Utility</color> switches Hsin back to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> to perform the corresponding action.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in the deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and air-borne.

<size=40><color=Title>Pillars Across Heaven</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and exits the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Edict</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Formshift</color> grants Hsin <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Edict</color> for {2}s. The effect cannot exceed <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After the active Resonator in the team deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes <color=Highlight>Edict</color> in the following {1}s trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the durtion:
- When <color=Highlight>Edict</color> is consumed, summon a <color=Highlight>Soaring Pillar</color> from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 
- <color=Highlight>Edict</color> can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by <color=Highlight>Soaring Pillar</color> does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all <color=Highlight>Edict</color> stacks are cleared.

<size=40><color=Title>Heart Manifest</color></size>
Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for {2}s.
Entering the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state resets Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state and in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, if <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> has not been unlocked, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to have Hsin cast <color=Highlight>Invoked Form: Answering</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to have Hsin cast <color=Highlight>Invoked Form: Illumining</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Invoked Form: Answering</color></size>
Hsin temporarily reverts to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, pausing the duration timer of the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state.
When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color>; if She is in mid-air, She casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Invoked Form: Illumining</color></size>
Hsin turns back into <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, resuming the duration timer of the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state.
When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Illumining Form</color>; if She is in mid-air, She casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color>.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. Enter <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, unlocking a new set of combat abilities.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation Finisher</color></size>
Deal massive <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and return Hsin to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Coordinated Attack</color></size>
After <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is cast, Hsin performs Coordinated Attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skill.name: Tides of Succession
skill.desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, when Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color>, She gains {0} Electro DMG Bonus for {1}s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, after Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, Hsin gains {2} Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to {3} times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury</color>, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain {6} Electro DMG Bonus for 7s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
skill.simple_desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, Hsin deals more DMG for a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Intro Skill</color>.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight>Electro Flare</color>, Hsin deals more DMG. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, while in combat, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, Hsin and Rover: Electro deal more Electro DMG.

skill.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
skill.desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, the maximum stacks of the <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> effect on Resonators in the team are increased by {0}. When a Resonator in the team triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, all Resonators in the team gain <SapTag=1>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> for {2}s. This effect can only grant up to <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color>.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color> and Hsin is not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, Hsin gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Thunderglow</color> after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, stacking up to {1} times.
While Hsin is in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, when targets within a certain range around the active Resonator have 0 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, inflict 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the targets. If <color=Highlight>Thunderglow</color> on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> on the target, she also inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target to the stack limit, up to {3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> is active, if the maximum stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target are increased, Hsin will inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target to the stack limit again, up to {3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> is active, the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks on the target will not be reduced when automatically triggered.
- <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state or switching Resonance Mode removes the effects mentioned above.
skill.simple_desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, <color=Highlight>Unison Boon</color> stacks on Resonators in the team are increased.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, for a certain time after Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, She inflicts <color=Highlight>Electro Flare</color> on the targets within a certain range nearby to the stack limit, and those targets no longer lose <color=Highlight>Electro Flare</color> stacks each time it is triggered automatically.

skill.name: Glance on a Whim
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color> (when in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>) or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color> (when in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>).

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color></size>
The skill becomes available when in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing greater <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color></size>
The skill becomes available when in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing greater <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
skill.simple_desc:

<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Intro Skill</color></size>

skill.name: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Forms Born of Heart</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, Hsin can gain and consume <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, Hsin can gain and consume <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color> reaches {0} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA. Hsin is immune to DMG and interruption during the action, and deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color>. This <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> to become <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Protector</color>, dealing greater DMG. <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> can only be gained once every {16}s.
While casting <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color>, if Hsin is not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, consume {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color> and unlock <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when Hsin consumes all of her <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> during the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color>. This <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color> to become <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color>, dealing greater DMG. <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color> can only be gained once every {16}s.
After casting <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color>, Hsin exits the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> is unlocked.

<size=40><color=Title>Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> reaches {1} points, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>.
When Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to surrounding targets, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>, Hsin enters the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Mechanism Dominion</color></size>
The <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state lasts {2}s.
While this state is active, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form</color> is further enhanced into <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> hits a target, <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> is consumed if Hsin is on the field.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Unison</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color> for {17}s.
- When Hsin triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, She gains <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color>, and the <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> cast this time is replaced with <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Manifold Unison</color>, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> without triggering <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color> while holding <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color>, She consumes <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color> instead, and the <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Manifold Unison</color>, dealing greater DMG.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> sends Hsin directly into the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state.
- When Hsin swiches Resonance Mode, <color=Highlight><te href=131119>Source Intent</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>【<te href=131111>Unison Boon</te>】</color> are removed.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, Hsin gains the following effects:
- After Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> to a target, every <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> inflicted grants Hsin <SapTag=0>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color>, stacking up to {5} times, and consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> stacks from that target. <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>hits a target, if Hsin has at least <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=7} of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color>, then consume <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=7} of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> to trigger 1 instance of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to {8} times the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks on the target.
Some time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> at once to trigger 1 instance of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG. Its DMG Multiplier equals to {9} x (the number of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> stacks consumed this time) x (the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks).
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early will end the above effects early.
- After <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> is cast, inflict <SapTag=E>{18}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the nearby targets within a certain range. When <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> hits a target, Hsin inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> to that target. This can take effect up to {12} times. Each time Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>, the number of times it can take effect is reset. When Hsin switches Resonance Mode, the number of times it can take effect is removed.
<color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> and <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> inflict <SapTag=E>{18}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit. <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color> inflict <SapTag=F>{19}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>
While Hsin is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color> with <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and <color=Highlight>Unison</color> at the same time, only <color=Highlight>Unison</color> is consumed to trigger the effect.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison Response</color></size>
While Hsin is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color> and another Resonator in the team has <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color>, switching to Hsin grants <SapTag=G>{20}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> to all Resonators in the team for {21}s.
Hsin can only grant up to <SapTag=G>{20}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> in this way. Retriggering the effect resets the duration.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison Boon</color></size>
Each stack of <color=Highlight>Unison Boon</color> increase the total DMG dealt by Resonators with the <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color> ability in the team by {22}, stacking up to {23} times.

<size=40><color=Title>Answering Heart</color></size>
Can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Answering Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Answering Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> hits a target, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color> if She is on the field.
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> grants {13} points of <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Illumining Heart</color></size>
Can hold up to {1} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> hits a target, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> if She is on the field.
- While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> directly sends Hsin into the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state and grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>, the next time the <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> generated by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1</color> is collapsed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>, gain {11} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> if Hsin is on the field. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

1.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
1.desc:
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> grants Hsin 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Radiance Ward</color>, stacking up to {0} times. Switching to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Radiance Ward</color> can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by {1} for {2}s. This effect can be triggered once every {3}s.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> are increased by {6}, and each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> by {7}, up to a total {8} stacks.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>:
When Hsin enters combat, if <color=Highlight><te href=131113>Heart of Thunder</te></color> is below {13} stacks, it is increased to {13} stacks, triggered once every {12}s.
When <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Resonance Skill: Illumining Form</color> hits a target, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG dealt by consuming <SapTag=14>{14}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of <color=Highlight><te href=131113>Heart of Thunder</te></color> is increased to {15}, and the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG dealt by consuming all remaining <color=Highlight><te href=131113>Heart of Thunder</te></color> at once is increased to {16}.

2.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
2.desc:
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> and <color=Highlight>Answering Form: Realm Protector</color> are increased by {0}.
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> and <color=Highlight>Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> are increased by {1}.

When Hsin enters combat, the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color> are reset. If Hsin is in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {2} additional points of <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color> are also restored. This effect can be triggered once every {3}s.

3.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
3.desc:
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> is increased by {0}.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> is increased by {1}, and each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> additionally increases its Crit. DMG by {2}, stacking up to {3} times.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>:
When the last stage of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> hits a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, it triggers 1 instance of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to {4} times the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks on the target.

4.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
4.desc: When Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> to a target, or when Resonators in the team gain <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color> or trigger <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, all Resonators in the team gain {0} All-Attribute DMG Bonus for {1}s.

5.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
5.desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by {0}.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores {1} of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for {2}s. This effect can be triggered once every <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=minute P=minutes SapTag=3}.

6.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living

Targets take {0} more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores {2} of the target's DEF.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The maximum stacks of the <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> effect on Resonators in the team are increased by {1}. When a Resonator in the team triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, all Resonators in the team gain <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> for {5}s. While in combat, <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at {3} and Crit. DMG fixed at {4}.
